requirement.functional.name: OrderService
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A payment attempted against an order that was never stored
requirement.functional.@statement: Every placed order is recorded before payment is attempted

requirement.functional.name: OrderRecord
requirement.functional.@counterexample: An order row that cannot say who placed it
requirement.functional.@statement: An order records what was bought and for how much

requirement.functional.name: TranscribableReference
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A reference that is a raw uuid
requirement.functional.@statement: An order carries a reference a customer can read down a phone line

requirement.functional.name: OrderExpiry
requirement.functional.@counterexample: Stock held indefinitely against an order nobody paid for
requirement.functional.@statement: An unpaid order carries the instant it stops being reservable

requirement.architectural.name: UuidPrimaryKeys
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: An entity keyed by a composite string
requirement.architectural.@statement: Every entity has a uuid primary key

requirement.architectural.name: SoftDeleteEverywhere
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: A hard delete on a table that promised its rows were recoverable
requirement.architectural.@statement: Every table carries a soft-delete flag rather than deleting rows
